paper.title: Athena-WBC: Capability-Aligned Policy Experts for Long-Tail Humanoid Whole-Body Control
paper.source_version: Current arXiv v3 (2026-08-24) withdrawn; mechanism extraction from archived v2 (2026-07-07), PDF SHA-256 ce14fd2a8569b9016316883b3190e00eafa41b6349cb2bedcaea9314e2723b5a, source-archive SHA-256 e1bbf1519bad0b205cdf5442d9c17ad79c623635215ae754ab441d4c84a7a5ac; no public code revision linked

decision_relevance.why_admitted: Archived v2 gives a concrete reward-decomposition hypothesis, per-motion empirical routing pattern, and threshold/salience-aware evaluation metrics. Current v3 withdrawal makes the dataset and all reported results inadmissible; the node is retained only as a quarantined hypothesis and fixed-trainer counterexample.
not_evidence_for: Any Athena-WBC performance claim, because arXiv v3 tells readers not to rely on the results while dataset authorization and governance are unresolved
A reference-composition or OGMP oracle method; Athena routes teacher supervision, not references or state-machine modes
Improvement under Sam's fixed trainer; Athena changes reward, observations, gravity, sampling, teacher count, DAgger, and PPO fine-tuning
Real-robot deployment, code availability, reproducibility, or RL-Sculptor implementation

mechanisms.name: Residual failure mining
mechanisms.description: Evaluate a general privileged teacher for 10 stochastic rollouts per training clip and admit clips with empirical success below 0.8 to one fixed residual set.

mechanisms.name: Tracking-focused dynamic expert
mechanisms.description: Train on residual clips with tracking rewards and physical-constraint penalties retained, effort and temporal-control reward terms removed, and a second-difference actor-mean loss used for smoothness.

mechanisms.name: Balance expert gravity curriculum
mechanisms.description: Scale gravity from an unspecified reduced value toward nominal gravity during training to extend early rollouts; evaluate only at nominal dynamics.

mechanisms.name: Per-motion best-teacher routing
mechanisms.description: Freeze the general, dynamic, and balance teachers, then assign each training clip to the teacher with the highest empirical rollout success for distillation labels.

mechanisms.name: DAgger distillation and PPO fine-tuning
mechanisms.description: Roll out a deployable-observation student, label visited states with the routed privileged teacher, then run critic warm-up, gradual actor unfreezing, and PPO fine-tuning.

mechanisms.name: Max-over-bin adaptive motion sampling
mechanisms.description: Smooth threshold-normalized tracking errors per temporal bin, reduce each clip to its maximum bin difficulty, clip extremes, and mix difficulty-weighted sampling with a uniform component.

failure_modes.name: Withdrawn for dataset authorization and governance concerns
failure_modes.description: Current arXiv v3 says the unresolved concerns affect the experimental dataset and consequently the reported results, and tells readers not to rely on the work.

failure_modes.name: Reference quality and feasibility confound failure attribution
failure_modes.description: Archived v2 states that residual failures may come from imperfect retargeting, data artifacts, or motions near embodiment limits, rather than the policy alone.

failure_modes.name: RL fine-tuning trades training coverage for held-out metrics
failure_modes.description: Archived v2 reports that PPO fine-tuning worsens several full-training and diagnostic-subset metrics relative to the multi-teacher student even as held-out metrics improve.

failure_modes.name: Low-frequency sway survives local smoothness regularization
failure_modes.description: Archived v2 reports slow periodic sway and says increasing CAPS or Grad-CAPS weight did not eliminate it.

failure_modes.name: Essential mechanism hyperparameters are omitted
failure_modes.description: The manuscript does not report alpha_min or the gravity schedule, Grad-CAPS lambda_reg, adaptive-sampler beta/D_max/epsilon/rho, DAgger auxiliary weight, or critic/actor fine-tuning schedules and noise magnitudes.

failure_modes.name: Recipe-level baseline on a different embodiment
failure_modes.description: The paper uses a SONIC-recipe reimplementation on an 80 kg XPENG humanoid, not the released SONIC checkpoint, and says absolute numbers are not directly comparable.

failure_modes.name: Behavior under saturated training is not established
failure_modes.description: Archived v2 describes its compute budget as relatively small and calls for larger-budget, more-converged experiments.

failure_modes.name: No systematic quantitative real-robot validation
failure_modes.description: Archived v2 says deployment is in progress on an internal, unreleased XPENG platform and defers systematic quantitative real-robot evaluation.

failure_modes.name: Multi-stage pipeline violates a fixed-trainer comparison
failure_modes.description: Mining, multiple privileged teachers, routing, DAgger, curricula, sampling, and PPO fine-tuning add coupled variables and engineering cost beyond a two-knob harness.

evaluation.name: Full-horizon thresholded rollout evaluation
evaluation.description: Final deployable-observation policies use deterministic action means; each clip receives five domain-randomized rollouts per seed over three training seeds, and any threshold violation fails the rollout.

evaluation.name: Success–Tolerance Curve and Threshold-Integrated Success
evaluation.description: STC scales all three success thresholds by s; TIS integrates SR(s) over s >= 0 with weight (1+s)^-2 to expose threshold sensitivity without selecting a maximum tolerance.

evaluation.name: Motion-Salience Weighted MPJPE
evaluation.description: Reference-only heading-local cumulative motion, normalized by root-to-point path length, supplies fixed per-clip point weights for tracking error.

evaluation.name: Archived v2 held-out comparison (withdrawn)
evaluation.description: v2 reports SONIC-Base to RL-finetuned changes of AMASS SR 98.18% to 99.26%, TIS 0.7631 to 0.8034, MPJPE 68.26 to 63.63 mm; Omni SR 91.81% to 94.89%, TIS 0.7123 to 0.7449, MPJPE 70.39 to 65.11 mm. These are not admissible evidence after v3 withdrawal.

evaluation.name: Archived v2 long-tail comparison (withdrawn)
evaluation.description: v2 reports multi-teacher balance SR 94.73% and MPJPE-W 88.61 mm versus SONIC-Base 90.60% and 101.99 mm, while RL fine-tuning degrades balance SR to 92.55% and MPJPE-W to 93.41 mm. These are not admissible evidence after v3 withdrawal.

evaluation.name: Archived v2 smoothness-placement ablation (withdrawn)
evaluation.description: v2 reports action rate 0.5447 for SONIC-Base, 1.4634 for NoSmooth, 0.8463 for CAPS, and 0.5627 for Grad-CAPS. These are not admissible evidence after v3 withdrawal.

evidence.locator: Status banner, Comments, and Submission history; v3 dated 2026-08-24
evidence.claim: The paper is withdrawn because unresolved authorization and data-governance concerns affect the experimental dataset and reported results; readers are told not to rely on the work.

evidence.locator: Archived v2, Figure 1 and Method opening
evidence.claim: The pipeline trains a general teacher, mines residual clips, trains dynamic and balance experts, routes frozen teachers per motion, distills one student, and PPO-fine-tunes it.

evidence.locator: Archived v2, Section 3.1, equations success_rate, residual_failure_set_gen, and policy_set
evidence.claim: Residual mining uses 10 rollouts per clip, a strict 0.8 empirical-success cutoff, and a bank of three teachers.

evidence.locator: Archived v2, Section 2.1 reward_components and Section 3.1 equations caps_reward_family through ppo_gradcaps_loss
evidence.claim: The dynamic expert keeps tracking and physical-constraint terms, removes effort and temporal reward terms, and adds an actor-mean second-difference regularizer.

evidence.locator: Archived v2, Section 3.1, equation gravity_curriculum
evidence.claim: The balance expert gradually raises gravity scale from alpha_min to nominal and evaluates under nominal dynamics.

evidence.locator: Archived v2, Section 3.2, equations routed_teacher_index and routing_table
evidence.claim: Each motion is assigned to the frozen teacher with the highest empirical success rate; routing selects supervision during distillation.

evidence.locator: Archived v2, Sections 3.3–3.4, equation distill_loss
evidence.claim: A student labels its visited states with routed privileged-teacher actions, then receives critic-only warm-up, gradual actor unfreezing, and PPO fine-tuning.

evidence.locator: Archived v2, Appendix B, equations bin_score through clip_rollout_prob
evidence.claim: The adaptive sampler smooths per-bin threshold-normalized errors, uses each clip's maximum bin difficulty, clips extremes, and mixes with uniform sampling.

evidence.locator: Archived v2, Table 1
evidence.claim: The expert actor observation has 1,837 dimensions and the deployable student has 2,081 dimensions.

evidence.locator: Archived v2, Section 4.1 Experimental Setup
evidence.claim: The paper reports 55,482 clips/175.88 hours, an 80 kg unreleased XPENG humanoid, a same-platform SONIC recipe reimplementation, 8 GPUs, 16,384 environments, and 40,000 main iterations.

evidence.locator: Archived v2, Section 4.2, equations success_rate_threshold through TIS_def
evidence.claim: Evaluation averages three seeds and five rollouts per clip and uses 0.20 m root-height, 0.50 rad yaw, and 0.50 m max key-body full-horizon thresholds.

evidence.locator: Archived v2, Section 4.2 and Appendix C, equations STC_s, TIS, and MPJPE_W
evidence.claim: The paper defines STC, TIS with weighting (1+s)^-2, and reference-derived Motion-Salience Weighted MPJPE.

evidence.locator: Archived v2, Table 3 heldout_results and text immediately below
evidence.claim: Archived v2 reports held-out SR, TIS, MPJPE, MPJPE-W, and action-rate comparisons; v3 withdrawal makes these results inadmissible.

evidence.locator: Archived v2, Table 4 long_tail_recovery and analysis
evidence.claim: Archived v2 reports long-tail expert specialization and worse post-fine-tuning training-subset metrics; v3 withdrawal makes these results inadmissible.

evidence.locator: Archived v2, Table smoothness_ablation and figures smoothness_clip_scatter, smoothness_action_psd, and smoothness_case_timeseries
evidence.claim: Archived v2 reports a tracking-versus-action-jitter trade-off across reward smoothness, NoSmooth, CAPS, and Grad-CAPS; v3 withdrawal makes these results inadmissible.

evidence.locator: Archived v2, Appendix A, Table ppo-hparams
evidence.claim: The appendix reports the shared Adam/PPO hyperparameters, 16,384 environments, 8 GPUs, and a 40,000-iteration horizon.

evidence.locator: Archived v2, Appendix D, Generated manifests and scope
evidence.claim: The diagnostic pipeline reports 1,000 dynamic clips from 133 families and 1,000 balance clips from 396 families.

evidence.locator: Archived v2, Limitations section
evidence.claim: The paper reports incomplete coverage, reference/feasibility confounding, low-frequency sway, pipeline complexity, compute limits, and no systematic quantitative real-robot validation.

evidence.locator: Archived v2, Sections 3.1–3.4 and Appendix A–B; symbolic values contrasted with the hyperparameter table
